prompt:
Create a sticker sheet of one original character: a round-faced orange cat in a tiny green knitted beanie, drawn in a clean kawaii style with thick dark-brown outlines and flat colours.

Six stickers in a 3 x 2 grid, each showing the same character with a different expression, in this order: 1 delighted, 2 sleepy, 3 shocked, 4 smug, 5 crying-laughing, 6 confused. The character must be identical across all six: same beanie, same proportions, same outline weight, same palette. Only the face and small hand gestures change.

Each sticker has a thick white die-cut border with a rounded outline. Even spacing, no overlap, no text, no numbers, no background: fully transparent PNG.
